thread:
Amanda: Quick check — post-launch benchmark narrative + webinar URL flow. We pushed landing v2 yesterday and I want to confirm redirects, canonical targets, and keyword mappings before we send the partner email. TL;DR: is the redirect map ready and do we have schema/FAQ coverage for webinar pages? Preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/landing-v2 :eyes:

Raj: taking a look now. any CTR/organic regressions we should watch for in the past 24h?

Carl: GA shows a small dip on the routes that got A/B weight increased (mostly /blog -> /landing). i'll pull session paths and cohort. pinging @seo-bot for the redirect diff so we can sanity-check no loops.

seo-bot: Redirect diff generated for PR 4876. Summary: 12 changed rules, 3 new 301s, 1 removed redirect to /old-webinar. No detected loops. Diff snippet:

```
# redirects.conf (excerpt)
rewrite ^/old-webinar$ /webinar-hub/2026-03-landing/ permanent;  # removed -> now 301 to hub
rewrite ^/blog/(.*)-2025$ /blog/$1 permanent;                   # cleaned dated URLs
rewrite ^/landing$ /landing-v2 permanent;                      # canonicalize to v2
```

Emily: For schema, we kept the WebinarEvent JSON-LD + FAQPage on the hub, right? Also added `speakable` for the intros. Quick example we included in page head:

```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Webinar","name":"Redwood Inference: Serving at Scale","startDate":"2026-04-08T10:00:00Z","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar/serving-at-scale"}
```

Amanda: Correct — WebinarEvent + FAQPage. Two ask items: 1) confirm rel=canonical and hreflang (we have en-US only for now) are set on legacy blog posts that point to the hub; 2) confirm the redirect priority doesn't strip UTM params for partner links (we need utm preserved). If there are canonical conflicts, add rel=canonical on blog posts to point to /webinar-hub/.

Raj: I'll ensure the redirect rules preserve query strings (nginx `rewrite` + `proxy_pass` tweak). Targeting deploy of the redirect update by 15:00 PST. :thumbsup:

Carl: I'll update the internal dashboard (landing cohort + organic CTR) and add a short alert if CTR drops >10% over a 6h window after redirect deploy. Will ping #release-war-room when the redirects are live.

Amanda: Perfect. Emily — once Raj confirms, can you run a quick structured data test and share screenshots? If everything passes, i'll send the partner email with the benchmark narrative summary and the webinar registration link. :email: :rocket:

Emily: Yup — will run tests and post results here before 16:30 PST.

seo-bot: Note — sitemap updated (sitemap.xml) and pinged Search Console refresh for /webinar-hub/ and /landing-v2.

Raj: Deploying redirect patch shortly, will update thread with the exact deploy id.

Carl: copied. monitoring started.

Amanda: thanks team — keeping this tight. We'll reconvene if anything unexpected shows up. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
